data.name: TableBuilderCode
data.description: Retrieves employee pay rate information based on the specified PayrateId.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves employee pay rate information for a specified PayrateId from the Deel Local Payroll OData resource. Agents can query matching payroll data with supported filters and periods.
Use for: Look up a pay rate, retrieve payroll rate data, filter payroll records
Not supported: Creating or updating pay rates, processing payroll, employee management

meta.q: look up an employee's compensation band in our internal HRIS
